board
  api (backend, hono)
    projects: Project
      GET /projects
      GET /projects/[id]
      POST /projects
      PATCH /projects/[id]
      DELETE /projects/[id]
      GET /projects/[id]/tasks
    tasks: Task
      GET /tasks
      GET /tasks/[id]
      POST /tasks
      PATCH /tasks/[id]
      DELETE /tasks/[id]
    complete (endpoint)
      POST /complete
      steps: finish_task
  web (frontend, nextjs) uses api
    /projects: list of ProjectCard
    /projects/[id]: ProjectView
    /projects/new: form projects.create, then /projects/[id]
    /tasks/new: form tasks.create, then /projects
    /tasks/[id]: TaskView
    /complete: form complete, then /tasks/[id]
    ProjectCard(project: Project)
      shows: project.name, project.summary
      links to /projects/[id]
    ProjectView(project: Project)
      shows: project.name, project.summary, project.tasks as chips
      deletes via projects.delete, then /projects
    TaskView(task: Task)
      shows: task.title, task.status, task.due, task.project, task.finished_at
      deletes via tasks.delete, then /projects
  data (2 entities)
    Project
    Task
